Zack Polanski's Political Future Questioned Amid Leadership Bid

Zack Polanski has stated his intention to run for leadership again and continue his pursuit of becoming a Member of Parliament (MP). However, coverage from multiple outlets suggests his political future is uncertain, with one report stating his "star is fading" and another asserting he is "probably finished." These assessments follow a period where his leadership aspirations and parliamentary ambitions have been publicly discussed.
